name: button
summary: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link buttons in several sizes.
avoid_when: Navigation that is really a link; use link variant or <a>.

name: button-group
summary: Visually joined buttons or button + text.
use_when: split buttons, pagination-like controls, grouped actions
avoid_when: Unrelated actions.

name: context-menu
summary: Right-click menu.
avoid_when: Only path to an action; also expose it visibly.

name: dropdown-menu
summary: Menu of actions opened from a button.
avoid_when: Choosing a form value; use select.

name: attachment
summary: File/media attachment chip or card with title, description and actions.
use_when: uploaded files in chat, forms or records
avoid_when: Picking files to upload; use file-upload (it renders attachments for you).

name: bubble
summary: Chat bubble with variants and reactions.
avoid_when: Cards or alerts.

name: message
summary: Chat message layout: avatar, header, content, footer; grouped messages.
use_when: chat and assistant UIs, comment threads
avoid_when: Non-conversational lists.

name: message-scroller
summary: Scroll container that sticks to the newest message, with jump-to-bottom button.
avoid_when: Static content.

name: avatar
summary: User image with initials fallback; groups with overflow count.
avoid_when: Decoration where the face doesn't help recognition.

name: badge
summary: Small label for status, category or count.
avoid_when: Marking normal/OK values; leave them unmarked. Add status variants (success/warning) via cva, not classes.

name: carousel
summary: Swipeable horizontal slides.
use_when: image galleries, testimonials on landing pages
avoid_when: Hiding important content in back-office screens.

name: chart
summary: Recharts wrapper: themed container, tooltip and legend that read chart-1…5 tokens.
use_when: trends over time, comparisons, distributions, sparklines
avoid_when: Showing one number (use a stat card) or rankings of a few items (use a bar list with progress).
example: <ChartContainer config={{ visits: { label: "Lượt khám", color: "var(--chart-1)" } }} className="h-64"><BarChart data={data}><XAxis dataKey="hour" /><Bar dataKey="visits" fill="var(--color-visits)" /><ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} /></BarChart></ChartContainer>

name: data-table
summary: Data table on TanStack Table v9 (@medviet/ui): sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, column visibility; the standard list of records in MedViet apps.
use_when: danh sách hồ sơ, bệnh nhân, phiếu, dịch vụ có sắp xếp/lọc/phân trang
any list of records a user scans, filters or acts on
avoid_when: A handful of fixed rows: use table. Spreadsheet-like editing: keep cells as inputs inside table.
example: <DataTable columns={columns} data={records} />  // columns via createColumnHelper; row actions: RowActionsMenu; status: StatusBadge; export: ExportMenu (data-export add-on)

name: description-list
summary: Label–value pairs in a responsive grid; empty values show '—'.
avoid_when: Editable forms; use form fields.
example: <DescriptionList columns={2} items={[{ label: "Khách hàng", value: "Nguyễn An" }, { label: "Địa chỉ", value: addr, full: true }]} />

name: excel-import
summary: Read rows from an Excel/CSV file by header (accents/case/spaces ignored, aliases), with per-row errors; download a template with required columns and an example row.
use_when: nhập danh sách bệnh nhân, nhân viên, dịch vụ từ Excel
đăng ký đoàn khám từ file
avoid_when: Ongoing sync with another system: an API import.
example: const { rows, missingColumns } = await readSheet(file, [{ key: "name", header: "Họ tên", required: true }, { key: "phone", header: "Số điện thoại", aliases: ["SĐT"] }]);

name: export-menu
summary: [Xuất] → Excel (.xlsx with bold frozen header, filter, real numbers/dates) or CSV (UTF-8 BOM) for any rows; columns give raw values.
use_when: xuất danh sách hồ sơ, báo cáo ra Excel
avoid_when: Print-exact forms: print-sheet.
example: <ExportMenu fileName="ho-so" rows={rows} columns={[{ header: "Mã", value: (r) => r.code }, { header: "Ngày khám", value: (r) => new Date(r.at) }]} />

name: item
summary: Flexible list row: media, title, description, actions; groups with separators.
use_when: lists of people, files, notifications, settings rows
avoid_when: Tabular data compared across columns on desktop; use table.

name: kbd
summary: Keyboard key hint.
use_when: shortcut hints in menus and tooltips
avoid_when: Anywhere without a real shortcut.

name: marker
summary: Small inline marker line with icon/text, optionally as a centered separator or bordered row.
avoid_when: Headings; use typography.

name: progress
summary: Horizontal bar showing a value against a maximum.
use_when: capacity, quota, completion, ranked bar lists
avoid_when: Unknown-duration loading; use spinner/skeleton.

name: readonly-field
summary: A value shown but not editable, drawn like a filled-in input (dt/dd), so Xem and Sửa modes line up; destructive tone for clinical-safety values.
use_when: chế độ Xem của form: thông tin hành chính, tiền sử, kết luận
dị ứng, cảnh báo lâm sàng (tone destructive)
avoid_when: Dense key-value summaries: description-list.
example: <dl className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2"><ReadonlyField label="Họ tên" value={p.name} /><ReadonlyField label="Dị ứng" value={p.allergy} tone="destructive" /></dl>

name: rich-text-content
summary: Read-only rendering of rich text HTML, sanitized with DOMPurify, with the same typography as the editor.
use_when: showing saved notes, orders or descriptions written with RichTextEditor or coming from another system
avoid_when: Plain text; render it directly.

name: row-actions-menu
summary: A table row's actions behind one ⋯ button (DropdownMenu), keeping the action column narrow.
use_when: thao tác của từng dòng trong bảng: Xem, Sửa, In, Huỷ
avoid_when: One obvious action per row: a single Button.

name: stat
summary: KPI card (Stat) with big tabular value, unit, change (Delta) and baseline caption; Delta colors the change by good/bad.
use_when: KPIs and summary numbers on dashboards, reports and record headers
showing change vs a previous period
avoid_when: Long lists of numbers; use a table. More than 5 in a row.
example: <Stat label="Thời gian chờ TB" value={formatDuration(125)} delta={<Delta value={31} good="down" format={(v) => formatSigned(v, " giây", 0)} />} caption="ngưỡng 2 phút" />

name: status-badge
summary: Status chip: tinted Badge + full-strength dot, one tone per status (neutral, info, warning, success, destructive); typed status→tone/label map with defineStatuses.
use_when: trạng thái hồ sơ, phiếu, đơn, ca khám trong bảng, thẻ, tiêu đề
any workflow state that must be scannable by colour
avoid_when: Counts or categories without a workflow meaning: use badge. Long explanations: use alert.
example: const RECORD = defineStatuses<Status>({ waiting: { tone: "warning", label: "Chờ khám" }, done: { tone: "success", label: "Đã khám" } });  <StatusBadge {...RECORD[row.status]} />

name: table
summary: Semantic table primitives (header, rows, cells, footer).
use_when: any list where users compare values across columns
avoid_when: Fewer than ~3 columns or mobile-first lists; use item list or cards below md.

name: virtual-list
summary: Long list (hundreds–thousands) that renders only the visible window; renders everything under 100 items so Ctrl+F still works.
use_when: danh sách rất dài: hồ sơ đoàn, dịch vụ, danh mục
avoid_when: Paged data: data-table with pagination.
example: <VirtualList className="h-[60vh]" items={patients} estimateSize={64} getItemKey={(p) => p.id} renderItem={(p) => <Item>…</Item>} />

name: alert
summary: Inline message box with icon, title, description and optional action.
use_when: page- or section-level warnings and errors
avoid_when: Transient confirmations; use toast.

name: empty
summary: Empty state: icon, title, description and actions.
avoid_when: Loading; use skeleton.

name: info-hint
summary: An ⓘ that shows a secondary line on hover/focus (Tooltip); the text stays in the DOM for screen readers.
use_when: giải thích ngắn cạnh nhãn, tiêu đề cột, chỉ số
avoid_when: Information the user must read to act: show it inline.
example: Thời gian chờ

name: retry-alert
summary: Inline error strip with [Thử lại] right under what failed, instead of a toast; keeps what the user typed.
use_when: lưu thất bại cần thử lại tại chỗ
avoid_when: Whole-page failure: ServerError page / empty state.
example: {query.isError && <RetryAlert message="Không tải được lịch sử khám" onRetry={() => query.refetch()} isRetrying={query.isFetching} />}

name: skeleton
summary: Placeholder blocks while content loads.
use_when: initial load of lists, cards, charts
avoid_when: Actions in progress; use spinner.

name: spinner
summary: Indeterminate loading indicator.
avoid_when: Whole-page loads; use skeleton.

name: toast
summary: Transient notification (Base UI toast manager).
avoid_when: Information the user must act on; use alert/dialog.
example: toast.add({ title: "Đã lưu chương trình" })  // <Toaster> is mounted in App.tsx

name: calendar
summary: Month calendar for picking a date or a date range (react-day-picker).
avoid_when: Free typing of known dates; offer an input too.

name: checkbox
summary: Boolean or multi-choice checkbox, with indeterminate state.
avoid_when: Instant on/off settings; use switch.

name: combobox
summary: Searchable select, single or multiple, with chips.
avoid_when: A few options; use select or radio.

name: date-picker
summary: Date input with calendar popover in vi-VN (@medviet/ui): DatePicker, DatePickerInput (typed dd/mm/yyyy + calendar), DateRangePicker (từ ngày – đến ngày).
use_when: ngày sinh, ngày khám, ngày hẹn
lọc theo khoảng ngày (từ ngày – đến ngày)
avoid_when: Only a time: use time-input. Free-text dates.

name: field
summary: Form field layout: label, control, description, error; groups and fieldsets.
use_when: every form control that needs a label, help text or validation message
example: <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="name">Tên chương trình</FieldLabel><Input id="name" /><FieldDescription>Hiển thị cho khách</FieldDescription><FieldError>…</FieldError></Field>

name: file-upload
summary: Drag-and-drop or click-to-pick file area, size limit with message, chosen files listed as removable attachments.
use_when: attaching documents, images or invoices to a record or form
avoid_when: Avatar pickers with cropping (build on top of it).
example: <FileUpload value={files} onChange={setFiles} accept="image/*,.pdf" maxSize={10e6} hint="PDF hoặc ảnh, tối đa 10 MB" />

name: form
summary: Form wired to react-hook-form with a zod resolver; FormField renders label, control, description and the validation message.
use_when: any form with validation: create/edit records, settings, sign-up
avoid_when: A single search box or instant filters.
example: const form = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), defaultValues }); <Form form={form} onSubmit={save}><FormField name="name" label="Tên">{({ field, id, invalid }) => <Input id={id} aria-invalid={invalid} {...field} />}</FormField></Form>

name: input
summary: Single-line text input.
avoid_when: Long text; use textarea.

name: input-group
summary: Input with attached addons: icons, buttons, text (₫, %, https://).
avoid_when: Plain inputs.

name: input-otp
summary: One-time code input split into slots.
avoid_when: Other numbers.

name: label
summary: Accessible label for a control.
avoid_when: Inside Field; use FieldLabel.

name: native-select
summary: Browser-native select styled to match.
avoid_when: When you need search or rich items.

name: number-input
summary: Numeric input that shows locale grouping while typing (1.250.000) and returns a number, with a unit suffix.
avoid_when: Codes or phone numbers (they are text, not numbers).

name: questionnaire
summary: Step-by-step question flow with choices, progress, inputs, errors and actions.
use_when: surveys, onboarding quizzes, guided intake forms
avoid_when: Ordinary data-entry forms; use field.

name: radio-group
summary: Pick exactly one of a few visible options.
use_when: 2–5 mutually exclusive options the user should compare
avoid_when: Many options; use select/combobox.

name: required-mark
summary: The red * after a required field's label; stays in the accessible name ("Họ tên *").
use_when: nhãn của trường bắt buộc trong form
avoid_when: Explaining why a field is required: use FieldDescription.

name: rich-text-editor
summary: Rich text editor (Tiptap) with a token-styled toolbar: headings, bold/italic/underline/strike, lists, quote, link, undo; 'full' adds alignment and tables; optional character limit. Value is HTML; works inside FormField.
use_when: clinical notes, orders, descriptions, emails, announcements where formatting matters
avoid_when: Short plain fields (use input/textarea). Load lazily (React.lazy) if it is not on the first screen: Tiptap is large.
example: <FormField name="note" label="Nội dung">{({ field, id, invalid }) => <RichTextEditor id={id} aria-invalid={invalid} value={field.value} onChange={field.onChange} placeholder="Nhập y lệnh…" toolbar="full" maxLength={2000} />}</FormField>

name: select
summary: Dropdown to pick one option from a short list.
avoid_when: Long or searchable lists; use combobox.

name: signature-pad
summary: Signature capture (mouse, pen, finger) as a transparent PNG; keeps strokes on resize; MIN_STROKE_LENGTH rejects a dot or a brushing thumb.
use_when: người bệnh ký xác nhận, cam kết, biên bản
ký trên máy tính bảng tại quầy
avoid_when: Legal digital signatures (USB token, CA): use the signing service.
example: <SignaturePad ref={pad} label="Chữ ký người bệnh" onStrokeLengthChange={setLength} />

name: slider
summary: Pick a number or range by dragging.
avoid_when: Exact values; use input.

name: switch
summary: On/off toggle that applies immediately.
use_when: settings that take effect at once
avoid_when: Form choices saved later; use checkbox.

name: textarea
summary: Multi-line text input.
avoid_when: Short values.

name: time-input
summary: 24-hour HH:mm text input with a mask (colon fills itself, hour ≤ 23, minute ≤ 59); avoids the OS-locale 12-hour native time box.
use_when: giờ hẹn, giờ khám, giờ bàn giao
any time of day typed by keyboard
avoid_when: A date and time together: date-picker + time-input side by side.

name: toggle
summary: Single pressable on/off button.
avoid_when: Settings; use switch.

name: toggle-group
summary: Set of toggle buttons; single-select works as a segmented control.
avoid_when: More than ~5 options.
example: <ToggleGroup value={[period]} onValueChange={(v) => setPeriod(v[0])}><ToggleGroupItem value="7d">7 ngày</ToggleGroupItem><ToggleGroupItem value="30d">30 ngày</ToggleGroupItem></ToggleGroup>

name: accordion
summary: Stacked sections that expand/collapse, usually one at a time.
use_when: FAQs, grouped settings, long forms split into sections
avoid_when: Primary content the user always needs; don't hide it.

name: aspect-ratio
summary: Keeps media at a fixed width:height ratio.
avoid_when: Text content.

name: card
summary: Bordered surface grouping one topic: header (title, description, action), content, footer.
use_when: a panel of related info on a dashboard or detail page
avoid_when: Wrapping every element in a card, or nesting cards; use spacing/Separator inside one card instead.

name: collapsible
summary: Show/hide one region with a trigger.
avoid_when: Several sections where only one opens; use accordion.

name: direction
summary: Provider that sets LTR/RTL direction for components.
avoid_when: Vietnamese/English UIs; not needed.

name: page-header
summary: Page title block: breadcrumb, title, description, actions on the right, optional filter row below.
avoid_when: Card titles inside the page; use CardTitle.
example: <PageHeader title="Đơn hàng" description="128 đơn chờ xử lý" actions={<Button>Tạo đơn</Button>}><DateRangePicker value={range} onChange={setRange} /></PageHeader>

name: print-sheet
summary: A4 paper form to print (biên bản, phiếu, bảng bàn giao): sheet preview on screen, window.print(), app chrome hidden with print:hidden.
use_when: in phiếu khám, biên bản, bảng bàn giao, giấy hẹn
avoid_when: Data downloads: export-menu. Server-generated PDFs: render on the server.

name: resizable
summary: Panels the user can resize by dragging a handle.
avoid_when: Normal page layouts; use CSS grid.

name: scroll-area
summary: Scrollable region with a styled scrollbar.
use_when: a fixed-height list inside a card or popover
avoid_when: The whole page; let the document scroll.

name: separator
summary: Thin horizontal or vertical divider line.
use_when: separating groups inside one card or menu
avoid_when: Between every short list item; prefer spacing.

name: sidebar
summary: App navigation sidebar with groups, menu items, collapse to icons, and mobile sheet.
use_when: the main navigation of a multi-page app or back office
avoid_when: Single-page tools or landing pages; use a top header instead.

name: breadcrumb
summary: Path from section to current page.
use_when: detail pages two or more levels deep
avoid_when: Top-level pages or flat apps.

name: command
summary: Searchable command list (⌘K palette); also the list inside comboboxes.
avoid_when: A plain dropdown of a few options.

name: menubar
summary: Desktop-app style menu bar (File, Edit, View…).
avoid_when: Normal web apps.

name: navigation-menu
summary: Horizontal top navigation with dropdown panels.
use_when: marketing sites and landing pages with a top nav
avoid_when: Back-office apps; use sidebar.

name: pagination
summary: Page number links with previous/next.
use_when: long tables and lists split into pages
avoid_when: Short lists, or feeds (use load more / infinite scroll).

name: stepper
summary: Step indicator for multi-step flows: done / current / upcoming, horizontal from sm and vertical on mobile.
use_when: wizards, checkout, onboarding, long forms split into steps
avoid_when: Peer sections the user can visit in any order; use tabs.
example: <Stepper steps={[{ title: "Thông tin" }, { title: "Ưu đãi" }, { title: "Xác nhận" }]} current={1} />

name: tabs
summary: Switch between views of the same context; 'line' variant for page-level tabs.
use_when: record detail sections (Thông tin / Lịch sử)
avoid_when: Sequential steps (use a stepper) or more than ~6 options (use select). On mobile, let a long TabsList scroll: <Tabs className="max-w-full overflow-x-auto"><TabsList className="w-max">.

name: alert-dialog
summary: Blocking confirmation with cancel/confirm.
avoid_when: Non-destructive info.

name: confirm-dialog
summary: The last question before something is lost (Bỏ thay đổi? Xoá hồ sơ? Huỷ đăng ký?): AlertDialog with the screen's own copy; Esc/outside click = no.
use_when: rời trang khi form chưa lưu
xoá, huỷ, thao tác không hoàn tác
avoid_when: Reversible actions: just do it and offer undo in a toast.
example: <ConfirmDialog open={pending !== null} title="Bỏ thay đổi?" description="Nội dung chưa lưu sẽ mất." confirmLabel="Bỏ thay đổi" onCancel={() => setPending(null)} onConfirm={leave} />

name: dialog
summary: Modal window for a focused task.
avoid_when: Long content (use a page or sheet); confirmations (use alert-dialog).

name: drawer
summary: Bottom drawer with swipe handle (mobile-friendly).
avoid_when: Desktop detail panels; use sheet.

name: file-lightbox
summary: Full-screen file viewer: images (zoom), PDF (react-pdf, lazy pages, page counter), Word .docx (docx-preview), Excel/CSV/ODS (SheetJS, sheet tabs, first 1000 rows), text; paging between files, keyboard shortcuts and download. Each viewer is lazy-loaded.
use_when: opening attachments of a record (results, consent forms, invoices, spreadsheets)
avoid_when: Editing documents; pptx and other formats show a download fallback. For print-exact Word/Excel, convert to PDF on a server.
example: <FileLightbox files={[{ name: "ket-qua.pdf", url: "/files/ket-qua.pdf" }]} index={openIndex} onIndexChange={setOpenIndex} />  // with uploads: files={uploads.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, file: f }))}

name: hover-card
summary: Rich preview on hover.
avoid_when: Mobile-critical info (no hover on touch).

name: popover
summary: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.
use_when: date pickers, small filter forms, inline editors
avoid_when: Plain hints; use tooltip.

name: sheet
summary: Panel sliding from a screen edge.
use_when: record detail next to a list
avoid_when: Primary page content.

name: tooltip
summary: Short text hint on hover/focus.
avoid_when: Essential info or anything interactive.

name: format
summary: Locale formatting helpers (vi-VN): numbers, compact amounts, money, percent, signed change, points, dates, times, durations in words, relative time.
use_when: every number, amount, date and duration shown in the UI
avoid_when: Raw toFixed(), toLocaleString without locale, or ISO dates on screen.
example: formatMoney(1284500000, { compact: true }) // "1,3 tỷ ₫"  formatDuration(125) // "2 phút 5 giây"  formatPoints(1.3) // "+1,3 điểm"  formatDate(d) // "23/10/2026"
